x: Isoteh is one ad network for blogs, newsletters, apps, chat and games. Owners sell the space they already have, brands book it directly, and nobody reading is tracked. # Who these docs are for Owners You run a site, a newsletter, an app, a game or a channel and want to sell ad space. Brands You want your ad inside the pages, inboxes and games your customers already use. # Owners Owner quickstart : list a space and paste two lines. Integration guide : the whole process, from picking a spot to getting paid. Websites and blogs , newsletters , apps and chat , games and creators . Getting paid : when money is held, when it moves, and how to withdraw it. # Brands Brand quickstart : find a space, book it and upload your ad. Campaigns : pay per 1,000 views across every owner who opts in. Pixel and Conversions API : count sales from your ads without tracking anyone. Ad rules and sizes : what an ad can be, and what is never allowed. # More How it works , how views count and the API reference . SDKs for websites, apps, chat and games. Changelog and docs for AI tools .

A brand pays first, the owner approves, the ad runs where it fits, and the owner is paid once it has run. How a booking moves: the brand pays first, the owner approves, the ad runs and is counted, then the owner is paid. # The four rules The owner decides. They set the price for a day, a week or a post, and approve every ad before it runs. The brand pays up front. Money is held while the ad runs and only then paid out. Owners never chase an invoice. The ad, not the person. Views and clicks are counted. Nothing about the reader is stored: no cookies, no profiles, no IP addresses. Always labelled. Every ad carries the word Sponsored, and ads never appear in private chats. # Two ways to buy Direct booking Campaign How it is priced The owner's price for a day, a week or a post A price per 1,000 views you set Where it runs One space you picked Every space whose owner opted in, matched by topic and country Who approves The owner, before it runs Isoteh reviews the ad; owners choose to join the network When money moves Held at booking, paid to the owner after it ran Budget held at start, charged per minute as views come in, the rest returned # What the owner pastes Each kind of place has its own small piece of code: a script line for websites, an HTML block for newsletters, a function for apps, a billboard for games and a booking page for creators. The dashboard gives you the right one for each space. See the integration guide . # What happens to one ad One ad from request to sale. Nothing about the person is sent at any step. Each ad comes with a signed token. The view link and the click link carry that token, so we can count each view and click once without knowing who saw it. See how views count .

The handful of words used across Isoteh, in the order you meet them. # Places and spaces A place is something you own with an audience: a website, a newsletter, an app, a game or a creator channel. A space (called a slot in the code and the API) is one spot inside it where an ad can go: a banner, a native card, a newsletter block, a billboard in a game or a sponsored post. Every space has an id that starts with sl_ . Kind of space Where it lives Priced by Banner A website or app Day or week Native card A feed, a channel or under an AI answer, drawn in your own style Day or week Email block A newsletter issue Issue or week Game board A surface inside a game world Day or week Creator post A post on your own channel Post # Bookings A booking is a brand buying one space for set dates. Dates can't be sold twice. An unpaid booking holds its dates for 30 minutes, then lets them go. # Campaigns A campaign is a budget a brand spends per 1,000 views across many spaces at once. Campaigns hold ad groups , which hold ads . They only show on spaces whose owners opted into the network. # Views, clicks and events A view counts once when at least half the ad has been on screen for a second. See how views count . A click counts once and sends the reader on to the brand's page. An event is what happened after a click, like a sign-up or a purchase, sent by the brand. See Pixel and Conversions API . # Money All amounts are kept in whole cents with a currency code, so 50000 USD is $500.00. Isoteh keeps 15% of each booking; the owner keeps 85%. See getting paid .

List a space, paste two lines, and your first booking can arrive the same day. Make an account Sign up and pick Owner. Listing is free and there is no traffic minimum. Add your place In the dashboard, open Places and add your site, newsletter, app, game or channel. Give it a few topic words, like coffee, austin, recipes , so fitting brands find it. Add a space and set its price Pick the kind of space and its size, then a price per day, per week or per post. Turn on Approve each ad if you want to see every ad first (it is on by default). Paste the code Copy the code shown under the space and paste it where the ad should appear. HTML Copy
Share your booking page Every space has its own page at https://isoteh.amaete.com/book/sl_your_slot . Link to it from an Advertise with us page. Your space also appears in the marketplace . Until a brand books, your space can show your own house ad, an Advertise here card that links to your booking page, or nothing at all. Pick it in the space's settings. # Next Integration guide The full process for every kind of place. Getting paid When money is held and when it moves.

Find a space that fits, book it, upload your ad and pay. It goes live when the owner approves it. Make an account Sign up and pick Brand. Find space Open the marketplace and filter by kind of place, topic and country. Each listing shows the audience, the price and the dates still free. Book and upload Pick dates and upload your ad: an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 1.5 MB) or plain text with a title, a line and a button. See ad rules and sizes . Pay Pay by card through Stripe, or by bank transfer. The money is held, not paid to the owner yet. Wait for approval The owner approves the ad, and we check it. If the owner says no, your money comes back. Count the results Views and clicks show in Reports by ad and by day. Add the events tag to count sales too. Want to reach many owners at once instead of booking one space? Start a campaign and pay per 1,000 views.

The full process to add Isoteh ads to a site, a newsletter, an app or a game, from picking the spot to getting paid. For the short version, see the owner quickstart. # Before you start You have an Isoteh account set to Owner. See the owner quickstart . You can edit the page, template, email or code where the ad will go. # Process overview Design Decide where ads go and how many. One ad near the top of an article and one in the middle of a newsletter is plenty for most places. Create the spaces Add each spot as a space in the dashboard, with its size and price. Each gets an id like sl_8f2k… . Integrate Paste the code for your kind of place (below). The dashboard shows the same code with your own ids. Test Open your page. You should see your house ad or the Advertise here card. Check the dashboard: the space shows its first serve within a minute. Go live Make the space bookable and, if you like, join the network so campaigns can fill unsold days. Approve and get paid Approve bookings as they arrive. Money moves to your balance after each booking has run. # Pick the code for your place Place What you paste Guide Website or blog A div and one script line Websites and blogs WordPress A shortcode, after a 40-line plugin WordPress Newsletter An HTML block with the issue name Newsletters App or chat One function call, drawn in your own style Apps and chat Three.js game A billboard mesh Games Any other engine A JSON request and two links Any engine Creator channel Nothing: share your booking page Creators # Use the SDK or the API Use an SDK when you want the view counting done for you. The website script, the native SDK and the game SDK all measure what is really on screen and send the view once. Use the API when you draw everything yourself, for example in Unity, Godot or a server-rendered page. You call GET /v1/ad and then call the view link once the ad has been seen. You are then responsible for the view rule. Never count a view the reader did not see. Views counted against the rule are found in review, and those bookings can be refunded to the brand. # Examples # Website HTML Copy

One div and one script line. The space is kept free while the ad loads, so the page never jumps, and nothing about your readers is sent anywhere. # Add the code HTML Copy
Load the script once per page, even with several spaces. Each data-isoteh div becomes one ad. # Keep the layout still Give the box its size so nothing moves when the ad arrives. If you set a size on the space, the dashboard's code already includes it. HTML Copy
# Tell us what the page is about Topic words help pick a fitting ad. They describe the page, never the reader. HTML Copy
If the page has a tag, its words are used too. # What the script does Loads the ad only when the space is near the screen. Draws it inside a shadow root, so your styles and the ad's never mix. Labels it Sponsored and links out with rel="sponsored" . Counts a view once, when half the ad has been on screen for a second while the tab is visible. Sets no cookies and uses no storage. # WordPress Install the plugin Download isoteh.php and upload it under Plugins, Add New, Upload. It is a 40-line shortcode and nothing else. Set the server Under Settings, Isoteh, set the server address to https://isoteh.amaete.com . Place the shortcode Put it in any post, page or widget. Shortcode Copy [isoteh slot="sl_your_slot"] No plugin? Paste the website code into a Custom HTML block instead. It works the same. # Ghost Add an HTML card where the ad goes and paste the website code. To show it on every post, put the script line in Settings, Code injection, Site footer, and the div in your theme where the ad belongs. # Other site builders Any builder that allows an HTML or embed block works: Webflow, Squarespace, Framer, Wix and plain HTML. Paste the website code into it.

An HTML block for every tool that allows one, and a ready-made block for Substack. Every reader of one issue sees the same ad. # Ghost, beehiiv, Kit, Mailchimp and Brevo Paste this into an HTML block in the email. Replace ISSUE with a new name for each send; the date works well. HTML Copy
Sponsored
# One ad per issue Every inbox that opens one issue sees the same ad, so a newsletter reads the same for everyone. The first open of an issue picks the ad. Every later open and click of that issue uses the same one, so forwarded copies and late readers see what everyone else saw. # Opens and clicks Opens are counted when the image loads. Many mail apps load images ahead of time, so opens are an estimate. Clicks are exact: each link counts once per reader per day. # Substack Substack doesn't run outside code and stores images itself, so use the ready-made block. Open the kit Open this address with your issue name. It returns the ad's image, its text and the tracked link. URL Copy https://isoteh.amaete.com/e/sl_your_slot/kit?i=2026-11-06 Add the image Download the image and add it to the post. Link it Link the image and the words to the link the kit gave you, and write Sponsored above it.

Ask for a card and draw it in your own style. Cards come back for public channels, feeds and AI answers, never for private chats. # Get a card JavaScript Copy import { getNativeAd } from 'https://isoteh.amaete.com/s/isoteh-native.mjs'; const card = await getNativeAd({ server: 'https://isoteh.amaete.com', slot: 'sl_your_slot', keywords: 'channel topic words', ctx: 'public', // 'private' or 'dm' always returns null }); # Draw it The card gives you its parts. Draw them with your own components, and always show card.label . Field What it is label Always "Sponsored". Show it. sponsor The brand's name title , body Plain text, no HTML cta The button words, "Learn more" when the brand gave none image An image address, or empty for a text ad seen() Call once, after the card has been at least half on screen for a second open() Opens the brand's page through the click counter # Under an AI answer Pass the words of the question or the answer as keywords . The card is matched to the topic, never to the person, and the answer itself is never changed. Show the card after the answer, clearly apart from it. Never place a card inside the answer text or style it to look like part of the reply. It must read as a separate, labelled ad. # Private chats Ads never appear in private or direct chats. Send ctx: 'private' from one and you get null ; the server enforces the same rule.

Turn any surface in your world into a billboard. A view counts only when the player can really read it. # Three.js JavaScript Copy import { AdBoard } from 'https://isoteh.amaete.com/s/isoteh-three.mjs'; const board = new AdBoard(THREE, { server: 'https://isoteh.amaete.com', slot: 'sl_your_slot', width: 8, height: 4 }); board.mesh.position.set(0, 3, -20); scene.add(board.mesh); function frame(dt) { board.update(camera, renderer, dt, { occluders: [buildings] }); renderer.render(scene, camera); } // on tap or click if (board.hit(raycaster)) board.open(); Pass your own THREE , so the SDK carries no copy of it. The board shows the ad with a small Sponsored strip, an Advertise here card when the space is free, or a plain panel. # When a view counts In a game the board must face the player, be big enough to read and not be hidden, for a full second. Rule Value Part of the board on screen and not hidden At least half Share of the screen it covers At least 1.5% Angle from straight on At most 55° Time in a row 1 second These follow the common rules for in-game ads, so brands can trust the numbers. Nothing about the player is sent. # Any engine Unity, Godot or your own engine: fetch the ad, draw its image on a surface, call its view link once the player has seen it for a second, and open its click link on tap. HTTP Copy GET https://isoteh.amaete.com/v1/ad?slot=sl_your_slot&kw=racing,cars { "ad": { "kind": "image", "sponsor": "Juniper Coffee", "image": "https://isoteh.amaete.com/cr/….png", "width": 1200, "height": 600 }, "label": "Sponsored", "view": "https://isoteh.amaete.com/t/v?k=…", "click": "https://isoteh.amaete.com/c?k=…" } The GameAd class in isoteh-game.mjs holds the same rules without Three.js, if you want to port them. See the game SDK .

Sell sponsored posts on your own channel. Brands book and pay first, you post with a tracked link, and you are paid three days later. Add a creator space Add your channel as a place and a Creator post space with a price per post. Share your booking page Put it in your bio or media kit. URL Copy https://isoteh.amaete.com/book/sl_your_slot Accept a booking Read the brief and accept or decline. The brand has already paid. Post with your link Each booking gets its own short link. Use it in the post, then add the post's address in the dashboard. Get paid Three days after you add the post link, or as soon as the brand confirms, 85% moves to your balance. # If something goes wrong Either side can open a dispute from the booking. Our team looks at the post and the brief, then pays the creator or returns the money to the brand as credit.

Every ad waits for you. You see exactly what will run, on which dates, and you can say no to anyone. # What you see Each booking request shows the ad as it will look, the brand, the link it goes to, the dates and the amount already paid. # Approve or decline Approve and the ad runs on its dates. Decline and the brand gets their money back. You don't need to give a reason. # Our review too Every ad is also checked by us before it can run, and any change sends it back for review. We turn away anything in our brand safety rules . # Turning approval off If you trust the marketplace's review, turn off Approve each ad on a space and paid bookings go live at once. You can still pull an ad at any time.

The brand pays when they book. We hold the money while the ad runs, then 85% moves to your balance, ready to withdraw. Money is held from the moment a brand pays until the booking has run. Then 85% moves to the owner. # When money moves Kind of booking Moves to your balance Banner, native card, game board When the booking's last day has ended Newsletter When the booked issues have been sent Creator post Three days after you add the post link, or when the brand confirms # Fees Listing is free. There is no monthly fee and no setup fee. Isoteh keeps 15% of each booking; you keep 85%. # Withdraw Ask for a payout from Money in the dashboard, in US dollars to your bank or PayPal. Payouts are sent by our team today and marked Sent in your dashboard; automatic payouts are on the way. # Taxes You are responsible for taxes on what you earn. Keep your payout details and country up to date in Settings. # Disputes and refunds If a brand disputes a booking, the money stays held until our team decides. We pay the owner if the ad ran as booked and refund the brand, as credit, if it didn't.

Set a budget and a price per 1,000 views, and your ad runs on every space whose owner opted in, matched by topic and country. Add credit Top up your balance under Money, by card or bank transfer. Create a campaign Set the total budget, the price per 1,000 views, the dates, and the topics and countries to match. Add ad groups and ads Group ads by idea or audience. Every ad is reviewed before it runs. Start Starting holds the budget. Views are charged every minute; whatever is left comes back when the campaign ends. # Matching without tracking Campaigns are matched to the page, never the person: the topic words of the space and page, the kind of place, and the reader's country. There are no interest profiles and no retargeting, because we keep nothing to build them from. # Audiences and lists An audience is a saved set of topics, countries, kinds of place or sites. A list holds sites or topics to include or leave out. Lists never hold email addresses or people.

An ad is an image or plain text. No scripts, no HTML, nothing that moves on its own with sound. # Formats Format What to upload Image PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 1.5 MB. Checked by its bytes, never by its name. Text A title, one line and button words, in plain text Native card An image and text; the owner draws it in their own style Email An image; we add the Sponsored line Game board A wide image, 2:1 works on most boards # Common sizes Space Size in pixels Medium rectangle 300 × 250 Leaderboard 728 × 90 Newsletter block 600 wide, any height up to 400 Game board 1200 × 600 Native card image 1:1 or 1.91:1 Upload images at twice the size for sharp screens. The space's own size is shown on its booking page. # Never allowed Scripts, HTML, trackers or tracking pixels in the ad Pop-ups, auto-playing sound, or ads that pretend to be part of the page Anything in our brand safety rules

Count sign-ups and sales that came from your ads, from the browser or from your server, without cookies and without knowing who anyone is. The reference names the ad and the day, the same for everyone who clicked that ad that day. It never names a person. # How it works A click on your ad adds ?isoteh_ref=… to your link. The reference names the ad and the day, the same for everyone who clicked that ad that day, so it can never point to one person. You send it back with what happened, from the browser or from your server, and we count it against the ad. # The browser tag Add the tag to every page HTML Copy <script async src="https://isoteh.amaete.com/s/isoteh-events.js"></script> Send events where they happen JavaScript Copy isoteh('sign_up'); isoteh('purchase', { value: 24.00, currency: 'USD' }); Check it Click your own ad, then do the action. The event shows in Events within a minute. The tag keeps the reference only for that browser tab (session storage), sets no cookies, and sends nothing at all for visitors who did not arrive from an ad. A visit from an ad sends a page_view by itself. # Conversions API (from your server) Send events from your backend when the browser can't be trusted to: a payment confirmed by your processor, a renewal, a sale in a shop. Keep the reference from the landing page with the order. cURL Node.js Python Copy curl https://isoteh.amaete.com/v1/events \ -H 'Authorization: Bearer isk_your_key' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{"event":"purchase","ref":"REF_FROM_THE_LINK","value":2400,"currency":"USD"}' await fetch('https://isoteh.amaete.com/v1/events', { method: 'POST', headers: { authorization: 'Bearer ' + process.env.ISOTEH_KEY, 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ event: 'purchase', ref: order.isotehRef, value: 2400, currency: 'USD' }), }); import os, requests requests.post('https://isoteh.amaete.com/v1/events', headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['ISOTEH_KEY']}"}, json={'event': 'purchase', 'ref': order.isoteh_ref, 'value': 2400, 'currency': 'USD'}) # Request body Field Type Notes event text Lower case, like purchase or sign_up , 2 to 32 characters ref text The isoteh_ref from the landing page. Valid for 31 days. value whole number In minor units: 2400 is $24.00. Optional. currency text ISO code, like USD. Optional. count whole number How many, when you send several at once. Optiona

Views, clicks, spend and events by ad, ad group, campaign and day. # What is counted Number Meaning Serves Times an ad was sent to a page, app or game Views Times it was really seen, by the rule in how views count Clicks Clicks, once per reader per ad per day Events Sign-ups, sales and anything else you sent Spend What you paid, in your currency # Exports Download any report as CSV from the dashboard, or read the same numbers from the API .

Small files, no dependencies, served from Isoteh itself. Each one counts views by the same rule and sends nothing about the person. SDK For Load from Website script Websites, blogs, WordPress, Ghost https://isoteh.amaete.com/s/isoteh.js Native SDK Apps, chat, feeds, AI answers https://isoteh.amaete.com/s/isoteh-native.mjs Three.js board Three.js games https://isoteh.amaete.com/s/isoteh-three.mjs Game SDK Any engine, the view rules alone https://isoteh.amaete.com/s/isoteh-game.mjs Events tag Brands counting sales https://isoteh.amaete.com/s/isoteh-events.js WordPress plugin WordPress shortcode https://isoteh.amaete.com/wordpress/isoteh.php # Shared rules No cookies, no storage of anything about the person. Every ad is labelled Sponsored. A view is sent once, by the rule in how views count . Errors never break your page: on any failure you get no ad. # Coming next Unity and Godot packages. The JSON API already works from any engine today.

Reference for GameAd: the view rules for any engine, without Three.js. JavaScript Copy import { GameAd, RULES } from 'https://isoteh.amaete.com/s/isoteh-game.mjs'; // RULES = { minVisible: 0.5, minShare: 0.015, maxAngle: 55, seconds: 1 } # Use Load await ad.load() returns the ad, an Advertise here offer, or null. Measure each frame Work out what share of the board is on screen and not hidden, what share of the screen it covers, and the angle to the camera. Pass them to the class each frame with the time since the last. Let it count After one second in a row inside the rules it sends the view, once. Porting to Unity or Godot? Copy the four numbers in RULES and the same one-second logic; the JSON API does the rest.

A small JSON API. Ads, views and clicks are public; everything about your account needs a key. # Base address URL Copy https://isoteh.amaete.com # Authentication Public endpoints ( /v1/ad , view and click links) need nothing. Account endpoints need an API key in the header. Make one under Settings; it starts with isk_ and is shown once. Header Copy Authorization: Bearer isk_your_key Writes must be JSON with Content-Type: application/json . # Endpoints Method and path What it does Key GET /v1/ad Get an ad for a space No POST /t/v?k=… Count a view No GET /c?k=… Count a click and go to the brand No POST /v1/events Send a conversion Yes GET /v1/events Events by day or hour Yes GET /v1/overview Spend, views, clicks and events for a date range Yes GET /v1/reports Report rows by ad and day Yes GET /v1/market Search listed spaces No GET /v1/slots/{id}/snippets The code to paste for a space Yes # Money in the API Every amount is a whole number of minor units with a currency: {"amount": 50000, "currency": "USD"} is $500.00.

GET /v1/ad returns the ad for a space right now, an Advertise here offer, or nothing. Request Copy GET https://isoteh.amaete.com/v1/ad?slot=sl_your_slot&kw=coffee,austin # Query Name Required Meaning slot Yes The space id kw No Topic words, comma separated ctx No private , dm or direct returns no ad country No Two-letter country code, when you know it from context # Response An ad Space is free Nothing Copy { "ad": { "kind": "image", "sponsor": "Juniper Coffee", "title": "Beans by Friday", "body": "Small-batch beans roasted in Austin.", "cta": "Shop the beans", "image": "https://isoteh.amaete.com/cr/3f9c….png", "width": 1200, "height": 600 }, "label": "Sponsored", "source": "booking", "view": "https://isoteh.amaete.com/t/v?k=…", "click": "https://isoteh.amaete.com/c?k=…" } { "ad": null, "open": { "text": "Advertise here", "url": "https://isoteh.amaete.com/book/sl_your_slot", "from": "$40.00 a day" } } { "ad": null } source is booking , campaign or house .

Each ad carries two links. Call the view link once it was seen, and send taps through the click link. A view counts once: at least half the ad on screen, for one second in a row, while the page or app is in front. # View HTTP Copy POST https://isoteh.amaete.com/t/v?k=TOKEN (or GET, which returns a 1×1 image) Call it once, after the ad has passed the view rule . Repeats of the same token are ignored. Answers 204 . # Click HTTP Copy GET https://isoteh.amaete.com/c?k=TOKEN → 302 to the brand's page, with utm_source, utm_medium and isoteh_ref Open it in a new tab or the system browser. Robots are ignored and each reader's click counts once.

Errors are JSON with one plain sentence. Limits keep one page or one script from flooding a space. JSON Copy { "error": "No such slot" } Status Meaning 400 Something in the request is wrong; the message says what 401 No key, or the key is wrong 403 Your key can't do this 404 No such space, ad or booking 415 Writes must be JSON 429 Too many requests; slow down and try again 5xx Our fault; try again in a moment # Limits What Limit Ad requests 120 a minute from one place for one space Views 600 a minute from one place Clicks 60 an hour from one place Events from the tag 30 an hour from one place for one ad "One place" is a hash that changes every day and is kept only in memory, never stored.

One rule for every kind of place, so a view means the same thing on a blog, in an app and in a game. A view counts once: at least half the ad on screen, for one second in a row, while the page or app is in front. # The rule Place A view counts when Website, app, chat At least half the ad is on screen for one second in a row, while the page or app is in front Game At least half the board is on screen and not hidden, it covers at least 1.5% of the screen, it faces the player within 55°, for one second in a row Newsletter The image loads (an estimate; mail apps preload images) Creator post Not counted as views; clicks on the post's link are counted # Counted once Every ad sent carries a signed token. Its view and its click count once each, however many times they are called. # Robots and repeats Known robots and preview tools are ignored. Repeated calls from one place are held back by limits that use a daily-changing hash kept only in memory. # What we never use Cookies or local storage on readers IP addresses, stored or shared Device ids, fingerprints or cross-site profiles
